name: sonz-ai
description: Sonzai SDK skills for AI coding agents. Wizard-driven builds (sonzai-sdk), autonomous transcript-to-app builds (full-auto), tech-lead-reviewed builds with 2 gates (cto-loop), and an internal-staff dogfooding companion.

plugins.name: sonzai-sdk
plugins.description: Three skills for Sonzai SDK developers: wizard (sonzai-sdk: human-in-the-loop spec + plan), autonomous closed-loop (full-auto: transcript → running app, docker-compose deploy, functional QA + auto-fixer, zero operator prompts), and semi-autonomous (cto-loop: same pipeline + 2 operator gates + interactive 7-question tech-stack intake + operator-feedback fixer loop). Shared core: always-search-current-state hard rule, builder/fixer/auditor/version-checker subagents, postgres/postgres+redis/stateless docker-compose templates.

plugins.name: sonzai-internal-staff
plugins.description: Internal-only companion plugin to sonzai-sdk. Adds monolith + workspace awareness for Sonzai staff dogfooding. Requires read access to the private sonzai-ai-monolith-ts repo — useless to external users; do not install unless you are Sonzai internal staff.
